name: Palor's Fury
notes: Any enemy can be targeted and stunned by this. This includes all bosses. Any attack they are currently using will dissipate. That enemy will be locked in a stun, and the player casting it will also be locked in place casting it.
summary: Spend 10 stacks of Palor's Blessing to channel a long lasting stun that interrupts the attack of any single enemy, including bosses.
